independent_unit: speaker; combine both timing repeats within each policy first
primary_coverage_effect: 100*(sum fullcall credit - sum conservative credit)/sum offered; all eight sources and both timing repeats
source_consistency_effect: arithmetic mean of eight speaker-paired credit percentage point differences

bootstrap.resample: same source indices for both policies and all per-source offered denominators

mandatory_checks: original selected complete state/C/IDs and human CER unchanged between policies
separate unchanged c4 full actual trace closure
scope: Uncertainty is source-paired within the metadata-selected8–9s cohort; does not estimate natural prevalence or saturated capacity
